experiment: E14: layout of rendered UML3 views in CATIA Magic (user observation 2026-09-17: diagram elements overlap)
setup: Same 9 example views as E13. Run A: views as they are (no render). Run B: view usages with 'render asTreeDiagram' (asInterconnectionDiagram for the component view, asElementTable for the class table). Both runs call DisplayExposedElements.layout(result) and count intersecting sibling shape bounds.

predictions.claim: Run A: DisplayMode.toDisplayMode(view) is UNDEFINED for every view, because no view declares a rendering
Run A: at least one view has overlapping sibling shapes after display and layout
Run B: the display mode is TREE for asTreeDiagram views and NESTED for asInterconnectionDiagram
Run B: no view has overlapping sibling shapes after layout
